# Arzi rules (v1)

<!-- Generated by `python -m arzi.rules > RULES.md`. Edit rules.py, not this file. -->

**Simplified prototype rule set. Not legal advice. Regulations change.**

These rules turn the facts of a rejected claim into one of three verdicts. They label all
synthetic training data and cross-check the model's answer inside the app.

| Verdict | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `likely_contestable` | On the stated facts the rejection looks wrong. Worth a formal complaint. |
| `worth_asking` | Not clearly wrong, or a fact is missing. Ask the insurer before deciding. |
| `likely_valid` | On the stated facts the rejection looks correct. |

## How rules are applied

1. **Evidence for the family wins.** Every `likely_contestable` rule of the category is checked.
   If any one is clearly true the verdict is `likely_contestable`, even if other facts are missing.
2. **Never guess.** If none is true but one could not be decided because a fact is missing,
   the verdict is `worth_asking`. (A rule can still be decided with a fact missing: "A and B"
   is false as soon as A is false.)
3. Only when every contestable rule is clearly false are the remaining rules tried top to bottom,
   first match wins. A missing fact there also gives `worth_asking`, so `likely_valid` is only
   ever reached on known facts.
4. `months_continuous_coverage` is the number of whole completed months from
   `policy_inception_date` to `admission_date`. When both dates are known they override any
   stated month count.

## Rules by category

### `non_disclosure_ped`

| # | Rule | Verdict | Reason code | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `months_continuous_coverage` >= 60 | `likely_contestable` | `moratorium_completed` | Moratorium: after 60 months of continuous cover a claim cannot be contested for non-disclosure, except for established fraud. |
| 2 | `ped_disclosed_in_proposal` is true | `likely_contestable` | `ped_was_disclosed` | The condition was declared in the proposal form, so it was not concealed. |
| 3 | `condition_related_to_claim` is false | `worth_asking` | `condition_unrelated_to_claim` | The undisclosed condition has no link to the illness claimed for. |
| 4 | otherwise | `likely_valid` | `non_disclosure_stands` |  |

### `waiting_period`

| # | Rule | Verdict | Reason code | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `is_accident` is true and `waiting_period_months` <= 1 | `likely_contestable` | `accident_no_initial_waiting` | The initial waiting period does not apply to accidents. |
| 2 | `is_accident` is true, `waiting_period_months` > 1 and `accident_exempt_in_wording` is true | `likely_contestable` | `accident_exempt_in_wording` | Whether accidents escape a longer waiting period depends on the policy wording, so it is a fact of the case, not a fixed rule. |
| 3 | `months_continuous_coverage` >= `waiting_period_months` | `likely_contestable` | `waiting_period_served` | Counts continuous cover carried over through portability. |
| 4 | otherwise | `likely_valid` | `waiting_period_not_served` |  |

### `permanent_exclusion`

| # | Rule | Verdict | Reason code | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `exclusion_in_policy_wording` is false | `likely_contestable` | `exclusion_not_in_wording` | The exclusion the insurer cites does not appear in the policy wording. |
| 2 | otherwise | `likely_valid` | `exclusion_in_wording` |  |

### `no_hospitalisation_needed`

| # | Rule | Verdict | Reason code | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `hospital_stay_hours` >= 24 or `is_listed_daycare_procedure` is true | `likely_contestable` | `inpatient_stay_or_daycare` |  |
| 2 | otherwise | `worth_asking` | `short_stay_not_daycare` |  |

### `room_rent_proportionate`

| # | Rule | Verdict | Reason code | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `room_rent_charged_per_day` <= `room_rent_limit_per_day` | `likely_contestable` | `room_rent_within_limit` |  |
| 2 | otherwise | `worth_asking` | `room_rent_over_limit` | A deduction is allowed; check the deduction maths. |

### `documents_or_late_intimation`

| # | Rule | Verdict | Reason code | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | always | `worth_asking` | `documents_or_delay` | Resubmit the documents or explain the delay. |

### `policy_lapsed`

| # | Rule | Verdict | Reason code | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `premium_paid_within_grace` is true | `likely_contestable` | `premium_within_grace` |  |
| 2 | otherwise | `likely_valid` | `policy_lapsed` |  |

### `sum_insured_exhausted`

| # | Rule | Verdict | Reason code | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `restore_benefit_available_unused` is true | `worth_asking` | `restore_benefit_unused` |  |
| 2 | otherwise | `likely_valid` | `sum_insured_exhausted` |  |

### `other`

| # | Rule | Verdict | Reason code | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | always | `worth_asking` | `uncategorised` |  |

## What to ask the insurer for

- Always: "The exact policy clause relied on".
- Unless the letter says the Claims Review Committee approved the rejection: "Confirmation that the Claims Review Committee approved this repudiation".
- When the dates give a month count more than 1 away from a stated count: "Confirm policy inception date and continuity of cover, including portability".
- Some rules add their own item (for example the deduction calculation for room rent).
- When a fact is missing, the matching document or explanation is requested:

| Missing fact | Ask |
| --- | --- |
| `months_continuous_coverage` | The policy inception date being counted from, including any ported cover |
| `ped_disclosed_in_proposal` | A copy of the proposal form that was signed |
| `condition_related_to_claim` | The medical basis for linking the named condition to this claim |
| `waiting_period_months` | Which waiting period is being applied and its length |
| `accident_exempt_in_wording` | Whether the policy wording exempts accidents from this waiting period, with the clause |
| `exclusion_in_policy_wording` | The page and clause number of the exclusion in the policy wording |
| `hospital_stay_hours` | The medical opinion relied on to say hospitalisation was not needed |
| `is_listed_daycare_procedure` | The medical opinion relied on to say hospitalisation was not needed |
| `room_rent_limit_per_day` | The room rent limit applied and the deduction calculation |
| `room_rent_charged_per_day` | The room rent limit applied and the deduction calculation |
| `premium_paid_within_grace` | The premium due date, the grace period and the date payment was received |
| `restore_benefit_available_unused` | A statement of the sum insured used this policy year and whether restore benefit applies |

At most 6 items are listed; the required items above come first so they are never cut.
